Engineering

Hochdruckkraftstoff

Fuel oil pressurized to high levels for injection into main engine cylinders, delivered by high-pressure pumps as specified by engine manufacturer and SOLAS for efficient combustion.

What is Hochdruckkraftstoff?

How is Hochdruckkraftstoff used in maritime?

Definition

Fuel oil pressurized to high levels for injection into main engine cylinders, delivered by high-pressure pumps as specified by engine manufacturer and SOLAS for efficient combustion.

Operational example

Engine room, check all high pressure fuel lines for leaks and ensure all connections are secure before starting the main engine.
